{{Quote|My memory is good. In all the years I was gone, I never for a moment forgot your face, your strength, your eyes, Mallatobuck. I dreamed of the day that we could be married. Will you? Will you take me for your husband?|translated=1|Chewbacca, proposing to Mallatobuck|<ref name="Rebel Dawn" />}}
In [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]], a '''wedding''' took place between the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] and [[Mallatobuck/Legends|Mallatobuck]].<ref name="Rebel Dawn" /> The two had been in love for [[Standard year/Legends|years]],<ref name="Chewbacca 1">[[Chewbacca (2000) 1|''Chewbacca'' (2000) 1]]</ref> but Chewbacca had been away from the Wookiee [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] for long periods of [[Time/Legends|time]] serving a [[Life debt/Legends|life debt]] to the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]. Mallatobuck turned down several proposals during that time, holding out for her hero. When he and Solo visited Kashyyyk in 2 BBY, Chewbacca and Mallatobuck spent long [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] wandering through the forest together. Chewbacca then bagged a [[quillarat]] in the planet's [[Shadowlands/Legends|Shadowlands]] and presented it to Mallatobuck&mdash;her acceptance of the gift signaled their forthcoming [[Marriage/Legends|union]].<ref name="Rebel Dawn" />

The two wed the very next day on the branch of a [[Wroshyr tree/Legends|wroshyr tree]] outside of [[Rwookrrorro/Legends|Rwookrrorro]]. No priest officiated; per Wookiee custom, the two wed themselves. Mallatobuck wore a sheer veil of silvery gray, and Solo stood at Chewbacca's side as his "best [[Human/Legends|Human]]," in a nod to Human customs. Many other Wookiees attended as the two exchanged vows. A reception then took place where much food was served, and Wookiees danced, sang, and played wooden instruments well into the night. Later in the night, Chewbacca and Mallatobuck consummated their union and [[Reproduction/Legends|conceived]] a [[Lumpawaroo/Legends|child]]. The next day, Chewbacca left with Solo to continue serving his life debt.<ref name="Rebel Dawn" />
